select /*+OPT_PARAM('_optimizer_cost_based_transformation' 'off')*/ TT.validStatus, TT.quoteType, TT.tradeAmt, TT.rate*100 rate, TT.repoTerm, TT.repoType, TT.ouPartyName, TT.cpPartyName, TT.partyId, TT.ouTraderName, TT.cpTraderName, TT.settleSpeed, TT.vSettleDate, TT.mSettleDate, TT.tradeDate, TT.statisticalTimes, TT.quoteId, TT.trdId, TT.ps, TT.settleType, TT.deliverytype, TT.mDeliveryType, TT.ccy, TT.settCcy, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName, pledge.PLEDGE_NUMBER * 100 pledgePrin, pledge.PLEDGE_RATIO pledgeRatio from (
) TT left join REG_FIN_TOTAL_PLEDGE pledge on pledge.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = TT.quoteId left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on fp.FINPROD_ID = pledge.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID order by TT.quoteId

select T.totle_trade_id quoteId/*报价编号*/, T.quote_type quoteStyle /*报价方式*/, T.ps ps /*交易方向*/, T.ou_party_id mySide /*本方*/, T.ou_trader_id mySideTrader /*本方交易员*/, null ouTraderName /*本方交易员名称*/, T.counter_id counterId /*对手方*/, T.counter_trader counterTrader /*对手方交易员*/, T.repo_type repoMethod /*回购方式*/, DECODE(T.settle_speed, 0, '01', 1, '02') settleSpreedCode /*清算速度*/, T.ccy ccy /*币种*/, T.repo_term repoTerm /*回购期限*/, T.rate*100 price /*回购利率*/, T.sett_ccy settCcy /*结算币种*/, T.trade_amt tradeAmt /*交易金额*/, T.share_amt*100 shareAmt /*券面总额合计*/, T.dis_face_value convertAmt /*质押券折算总额*/, T.delivery_type deliverytype /*首次结算方式*/, T.m_delivery_type mDeliveryType /*到期结算方式*/, T.clear_type settleType /*清算类型*/, fee1.FEE_AMT dealFeeAmt /*交易手续费*/, fee2.FEE_AMT settFeeAmt /*结算服务费*/, T.remark remark /*备注*/, T.dip_type distribution /*分配方式*/, T.trade_date tradeDate /*交易日期*/, T.v_settle_date settlementStartDate /*首次结算日*/, T.m_settle_date settlementEndDate /*到期结算日*/, T.m_int_amt mIntAmt /*回购利息*/, T.m_trade_amt mtradeAmt /*到期结算金额*/, T.act_repo_term actCapDays /*实际占款天数*/, T.term_type termType /*期限品种*/, T.trade_market tradeMarket /*交易场所*/ from (
) T left join () fee1 on T.totle_trade_id = fee1.TRADE_ID and fee1.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' /*交易手续费*/ left join () fee2 on T.totle_trade_id = fee2.TRADE_ID and fee2.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' /*结算手续费*/

select fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID bondCode/*债券市场代码*/, fp.FINPROD_ABBR bondAbbrName/*债券简称*/, pledge.finprodId finprodId/*债券代码*/, MBCR.GRADE_RESULT gradeResult/*债券评级*/, null period/*代偿期*/, null pledgeStockName/*债券库名称*/, null pledgeStockId/*债券库代码*/, fp.MDATE mdate/*债券到期日*/, NVL(TABLE01.pledStrdPrinAmt,0) avaPledgePrin/*可质押券面总额*/, pledge.pledgePrin pledgePrin/*质押券面额*/, mbvi.NETPRICE firstNetPrice/*首次净价*/, pledge.pledgeRatio*100 pledgeRatio/*折算比例*/, fp.REGIST_ORG repRegistOrg/*登记托管机构code*/, pledge.portfolioId portfolioId/*组合代码*/, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName/*组合名称*/ from ( select portfolio_id portfolioId, pledge_finprod_id finprodId, SUM(pledge_number * 100) pledgePrin, pledge_ratio pledgeRatio from (
) group by portfolio_id,pledge_finprod_id,pledge_ratio ) pledge left join ( SELECT V.SEC_ACCT_ID AS SECACCTID, PSA.PORTFOLIO_ID, R.FINPROD_ID FROM PTL_SEC_ACCT PSA, STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO V LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT R ON R.REGIST_ORG = V.REGIST_ORG and V.TRADE_PLACE = R.trade_market WHERE PSA.ACCT_NO = V.SEC_ACCT_ID AND V.SEC_ACCT_TYPE = 'SEC') secAcct on secAcct.PORTFOLIO_ID = pledge.portfolioId and secAcct.FINPROD_ID = pledge.finprodId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID /*组合代码*/ ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID /*证券账户/通道代码*/ ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID /*分支序号*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,SUM(TEMP.pledgeAmount) pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM ( SELECT espr.PORTFOLIO_ID ,pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,espr.SEC_ACCT_ID ,espr.FINPROD_ID ,CASE WHEN ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE = #{S_002} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledStrdPrinAmt /*可质押券面总额*/ ,CASE WHEN espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012} THEN espr.AMOUNT*nvl(ppc.CAL_FLAG,1) ELSE 0 END AS pledgeAmount /*已质押质押券面总额*/ FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION_RULE espr INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON espr.PORTFOLIO_ID = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_POSITION_CFG ppc ON espr.HODING_TYPE =ppc.HOLDINGTYPE AND ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} WHERE espr.CDATE = to_date(#{platDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')/*组合持仓.日期 = 平台日*/ AND espr.DATE_TYPE =0 AND ( ppc.S_HOLDINGTYPE =#{S_002} or espr.HODING_TYPE=#{A_012}) ) TEMP LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID WHERE PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{loginUserId} GROUP BY TEMP.PORTFOLIO_ID ,TEMP.PORTFOLIO_NAME ,TEMP.SEC_ACCT_ID ,TEMP.FINPROD_ID HAVING SUM(TEMP.pledStrdPrinAmt) > 0 /*只统计可质押券面总额>0*/ )TABLE01/*以上统计可用持仓*/ ON TABLE01.FINPROD_ID = pledge.finprodId AND TABLE01.PORTFOLIO_ID = pledge.portfolioId and secAcct.SECACCTID = TABLE01.SEC_ACCT_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID, SUM(NVL(AMOUNT, 0)) AMOUNT FROM PTL_SEC_POSITION WHERE CDATE = TO_DATE(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AND HODING_TYPE = '04' GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID ) pledgePos ON pledgePos.PORTFOLIO_ID = pledge.portfolioId AND pledgePos.FINPROD_ID = pledge.finprodId INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = pledge.finprodId LEFT JOIN (SELECT RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY O_CODE ORDER BY GRADE_DATE DESC,CAST(GRADE_RESULT AS DECIMAL) DESC) NUM, O_CODE, GRADE_RESULT FROM MST_BOND_CREDIT_RATING WHERE GRADE_DATE <= to_date(#{platDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR},'yyyy-MM-dd') and GRADE_ORG_ID !='22' ) MBCR ON MBCR.O_CODE = fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID AND MBCR.NUM = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT T2.SEC_ID, T2.PRICE, T2.NETPRICE FROM ( SELECT tmp1.SEC_ID, tmp1.value_source, MAX(tmp1.value_date) AS value_date FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO tmp1 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT tmp2 ON tmp1.sec_id = tmp2.finprod_market_id WHERE 1 = 1 AND tmp1.value_date <= to_date(#{platDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')/*估值行情.日期 小于等于 平台日*/ AND tmp1.value_source = ( CASE WHEN tmp2.trade_market IN (#{TRADEPLACE03},#{TRADEPLACE04}) THEN 'CSD' ELSE 'CBC' END) GROUP BY tmp1.sec_id, tmp1.value_source ) T1 LEFT JOIN MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO T2 ON T1.SEC_ID = T2.SEC_ID AND T1.value_source = T2.value_source AND T1.VALUE_DATE = T2.VALUE_DATE ) mbvi/*以上获取债券小于等于平台日的最新估值行情*/ ON fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = mbvi.SEC_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO pp ON pledge.portfolioId = pp.PORTFOLIO_ID

select deal.ENTRUST_ID entrustId/*指令代码*/, deal.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId/*组合代码*/, pp.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName/*组合名称*/, ROUND((ee.ENTRUST_AMT) - NVL(T5.FINISH_AMT, 0) - NVL(T6.ENT_FINISH_AMT, 0) ) avaNum/*剩余指令额度*/, null avaNumold/*剩余指令额度*/, deal.TRADE_AMT tradeAmt/*交易金额*/, fee1.FEE_AMT dealFeeAmt/*交易手续费*/, fee2.FEE_AMT settFeeAmt/*结算服务费*/, deal.M_INT_AMT mIntAmt/*回购利息*/, deal.M_TRADE_AMT mtradeAmt/*到期结算金额*/, deal.DIS_FACE_VALUE convertAmt/*质押券折算总额*/, ee.PRICE_MODEL priceModel/*价格模式*/, deal.RATE*100 price/*回购利率*/, deal.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageAcctId/*证券账户*/ from (
) deal left join ETR_ENTRUST ee on ee.ENTRUST_ID = deal.ENTRUST_ID left join () fee1 on deal.TRADE_ID = fee1.TRADE_ID and fee1.FEE_TYPE = 'B06' /*交易手续费*/ left join () fee2 on deal.TRADE_ID = fee2.TRADE_ID and fee2.FEE_TYPE = 'B08' /*结算手续费*/ left join PTL_PORTFOLIO pp on pp.PORTFOLIO_ID = deal.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID , SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_QUOTE_FINISH_STATUS /*报价完成状况表*/ GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) T5 ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID , SUM(FINISH_AMT) AS FINISH_AMT , SUM(ENT_FINISH_AMT) AS ENT_FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS/*委托完成状况表*/ GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID ) T6 ON ee.ENTRUST_ID = T6.ENTRUST_ID
